pageSub: People, the roles they hold, and the teams that decide whose records they see. Applies to this workspace.
demoNotice: Demo workspace: nothing was saved or sent.
inThisWorkspaceOnly: In this workspace only; other workspaces are unchanged.
suspendedSub: Membership deactivated and sessions revoked. History is kept.
memberNotFound: That person is not a member of this workspace.
roleNotFound: That role does not exist in this organisation.
teamNotFound: That team does not exist in this workspace.
invalidBody: Some values are not valid. Check the highlighted fields.
errorBody: Something went wrong on our side. Nothing was changed. Try again.
conflictBody: Reload to see the current version, then apply your change again.
authz_org_suspended: This organisation is suspended. Changes are paused.
authz_org_readonly: This organisation is read-only until the trial is upgraded.
authz_module_off: This area is switched off for your organisation.
authz_support_blocked: Not available in a support session.
authz_no_permission: Your role does not allow this change.
authz_out_of_scope: That is outside what your role can manage.
authz_condition_failed: A condition on your role blocks this change.
deny_self_change: You cannot change your own role, status or team leadership.
deny_last_owner: This is the last active Owner. Make someone else Owner first.
deny_out_of_scope: Sales Managers manage Sales Reps and Viewers only.
deny_owner_only: Only an Owner can give or change the Owner role.
deny_needs_roles_manage: Custom roles need the roles.manage permission, which your role does not hold.
deny_role_exceeds_you: You cannot give more access than you hold yourself.
customRolesOff: Custom roles are switched off for this organisation.
customRolesOffWhy: The platform administrator controls this. Ask them to allow custom roles.
systemRoleReadOnlyWhy: Clone it to make a custom role you can change.
seatCap: Your plan allows {n} active seats and all are used.
inviteEmailSent: The invite email is on its way and expires in 7 days.
inviteEmailFailed: The invitation is saved but the email could not be sent. Use Invite again to resend.
inviteCustomLater: The custom role is applied when they accept; until then they hold the base role.
districtTaken: One of those districts already belongs to another person in this workspace.
roleSavedSub: Everyone holding this role gets the new access at once.
roleInUse: People still hold this role. Move them to another role first.
roleNameTaken: A custom role with that name already exists.
teamOwnParent: A team cannot be its own parent.
membersSub: {n} people. A role applies to this workspace only.
inviteDesc: An existing user is added at once. A new user gets an email invite valid for 7 days.
managerInviteHelp: As a Sales Manager you can invite Sales Reps and Viewers.
suspendDesc: Their membership here is deactivated and sessions are revoked. History stays; other workspaces are not affected.
territoryDesc: Districts decide which unassigned records a Sales Rep sees. One person per district in this workspace.
emptyMembersBody: Invite the first person to this workspace. They choose a password from the email link.
reasonSelf: You cannot change your own role or status.
reasonManager: Sales Managers manage Sales Reps and Viewers only.
reasonSupport: Not available in a support session.
reasonLastOwner: This is the last active Owner.
reasonOwnerOnly: Only an Owner can change an Owner.
reasonNeedsRolesManage: Needs the roles.manage permission to assign a custom role.
rolesSub: System roles are fixed templates. Clone one to build a custom role with exact scopes and conditions.
deleteRoleDesc: This cannot be undone. A role in use cannot be deleted.
emptyRolesBody: Clone a system role to start. Custom roles can only grant what you hold yourself.
customOffBody: The platform administrator has switched custom roles off for this organisation. System roles still work.
baseHelp: Sets the home page and the legacy defaults. It never adds permissions.
scopeHelp: Own: records assigned to them. Team: their teams. All: the whole workspace.
notHeld: You do not hold this, so you cannot grant it.
heldUpTo: You hold it up to {scope}. You cannot grant more.
condDistricts: Only records in the person's districts
condLocked: Your own conditions apply here and are kept.
roleChangedElsewhere: This role changed while you were editing. Reload to see the current version.
explainSub: Pick a role and a permission to see which step allows or blocks it.
teamsSub: Team scope shows a person the records of everyone in their teams. Managers also see the teams below theirs.
deleteTeamDesc: Members stay in the workspace. Records they own are unaffected; only team scope changes.
emptyTeamsBody: Create a team, add people, and mark who manages it. Roles with Team scope then follow it.
teamManagerSelf: You cannot make yourself a team manager.
loadErrorBody: We could not load this page. Nothing was changed.
deniedBody: Your role ({role}) does not include managing users, roles or teams. Ask an Owner.
deniedSupport: Support sessions cannot manage users, roles or teams.
